quarterly_data.quarter: Rocket Lab press release: MISSION SUCCESS: Rocket Lab Launches 94th Electron Mission (09-02-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Rocket Lab launched its 94th Electron (its 15th launch of 2026) from Launch Complex 1 on September 3, 2026 NZST, deploying a StriX SAR satellite for Synspective to a 575km orbit. Rocket Lab has been the sole launch provider for Synspective's constellation since 2020, with another 16 missions booked on Electron to deliver the rest of the constellation before 2030, and 100% mission success across all Synspective launches.
quarterly_data.figure: 94th Electron; 15th launch of 2026; another 16 Synspective missions booked
